note: The sandbox buyer opened PayPal's 'Report a problem' flow for sale maria-0036 (no dispute was filed). Before offering to report the problem to PayPal, PayPal showed the buyer the UPS tracking that SpikeReady had verified and uploaded to the order. Screenshot: docs/img/paypal-shows-buyer-tracking.png (cropped to the card; no account details).
pageNote: 8KV02832AG9431838 is the buyer-side transaction id PayPal uses in the filing path; the page was reached from the buyer's Resolution Center dashboard via 'Reportar un problema'.
uiLanguageNote: The sandbox buyer account is registered in Ecuador, so PayPal's buyer pages are in Spanish.
